structure:Dataflow.common:Description:
This dataset provides readily available, granular data on who is giving what aid, to where, and for what purpose, on a flow basis. These data are comparable across all providers who report their activity-level statistics to the OECD.

Please consult our database of development finance classifications for further information on all possible codes for each attribute.

Users of the "related files", which contain the raw data by year (or altogether in .parquet format), may find descriptions of each column on the sheet "CRS bulk data – codebook" of this Excel file.

For more information on these flows, please see the OECD's main page on official development assistance and finance for sustainable development, including frequently asked questions (FAQs) on ODA. See also the converged statistical reporting directives governing these data, alongside other guidance on using our data, and a DE User guide for DAC/CRS statistics. You may also be interested in our latest dashboards.

While you are here, please take a moment to answer our short survey to inform the next generation of dissemination tools of OECD development finance statistics.

Cet ensemble de données fournit des données granulaires facilement accessibles sur qui donne quelle aide, à quel pays et dans quel objectif, sur la base des flux. Ces données sont comparables entre tous les fournisseurs qui notifient leurs statistiques au niveau d'activité à l'OCDE.

Veuillez consulter notre base de données des classifications du financement du développement pour plus d'informations sur tous les codes possibles pour chaque attribut.

Les utilisateurs des « fichiers connexes », qui contiennent les données brutes par année (ou dans leur ensemble au format .parquet), peuvent trouver des descriptions de chaque colonne sur la feuille « CRS bulk data - codebook » dans ce fichier Excel.

Pour plus d'informations sur ces flux, veuillez consulter la page principale de l'OCDE sur l'aide publique au développement et le financement du développement durable, y compris la foire aux questions (FAQ) sur l'APD. Voir également les directives de notification statistique convergées (en anglais) régissant ces données, ainsi que d'autres conseils sur l'utilisation de nos données, ainsi qu'un guide d'utilisation de l'ED consacré aux statistiques du CAD et du CRS (en anglais). Nos derniers tableaux de bord pourraient également vous intéresser.

Profitez de votre visite pour répondre à notre brève enquête (en anglais) afin de contribuer à l'élaboration de la prochaine génération d'outils de diffusion des statistiques de l'OCDE sur le financement du développement.

structure:Code.common:Name: Normal value

structure:Code.common:Name: Time series break
Rupture de série
structure:Code.common:Description: Observations are characterised as such when different content exists or a different methodology has been applied to this observation as compared with the preceding one (the one given for the previous period).

structure:Code.common:Name: Definition differs
Définition différente
structure:Code.common:Description: Used to indicate slight deviations from the established methodology (footnote-type information); these divergences do not imply a break in time series.

structure:Code.common:Name: Estimated value
Valeur estimée
structure:Code.common:Description: Observation obtained through an estimation methodology (e.g. to produce back-casts) or based on the use of a limited amount of data or ad hoc sampling and through additional calculations (e.g. to produce a value at an early stage of the production stage while not all data are available). It may also be used in case of experimental data (e.g. in the context of a pilot ahead of a full scale production process) or in case of data of (anticipated/assessed) low quality. If needed, additional information can be provided through free text using the COMMENT_OBS attribute at the observation level or at a higher level. This code is to be used when the estimation is done by a sender agency. When the imputation is carried out by a receiver agency in order to replace or fill gaps in reported data series, the flag to use is I "Value imputed by a receiving agency".

structure:Code.common:Name: Forecast value
Valeur projetée
structure:Code.common:Description: Value deemed to assess the magnitude which a quantity will assume at some future point of time (as distinct from "estimated value" which attempts to assess the magnitude of an already existent quantity).

structure:Code.common:Name: Experimental value
Valeur expérimentale
structure:Code.common:Description: Data collected on the basis of definitions or (alternative) collection methods under development. Data not of guaranteed quality as normally expected from provider.

structure:Code.common:Name: Value imputed by a receiving agency
Valeur imputée par un organisme récepteur
structure:Code.common:Description: Observation imputed by a receiving agency to replace or fill gaps in reported data series. This code is intended to cover all cases where a receiving agency publishes data about a sending agency that do not come from an official source in the sender agency's reporting framework.When the estimation is done by the sender agency, the flag to use is E "Estimated value".

Valeur manquante; jour férié ou fin de semaine
structure:Code.common:Description: Used in some daily data flows.

structure:Code.common:Name: Missing value; suppressed

structure:Code.common:Name: Not significant

structure:Code.common:Description: Used to indicate a value which is not a "real" zero (e.g. a result of 0.0004 rounded to zero).

structure:Code.common:Name: Low reliability
